with inbound_layers as ( select t.product_id,t.transaction_id,t.create_time, sum(t.on_hand_change) over(partition by t.product_id order by t.transaction_id desc) cumulative_qty from jewelry_stock_transaction t where t.on_hand_change > 0 ), age_boundary as ( select l.product_id,max(l.transaction_id) boundary_id from inbound_layers l join jewelry_stock current_stock on current_stock.product_id=l.product_id where current_stock.on_hand_qty > 0 and l.cumulative_qty >= current_stock.on_hand_qty group by l.product_id ), warning_config as ( select coalesce(max(cast(config_value as unsigned)),25) warning_days from sys_config where config_key='jewelry.stock.warning.days' ) select p.product_id productId,p.sku,p.product_name productName,p.product_type productType, p.specification,p.category,p.warning_qty warningQty, s.on_hand_qty onHandQty,s.reserved_out_qty reservedOutQty, (s.on_hand_qty-s.reserved_out_qty) availableQty,s.inspection_qty inspectionQty, s.inspection_reserved_qty inspectionReservedQty,s.defect_qty defectQty, s.defect_reserved_qty defectReservedQty,s.avg_cost avgCost, round(s.on_hand_qty*s.avg_cost,2) stockAmount,s.update_time updateTime, date(age_tx.create_time) oldestInboundDate, case when s.on_hand_qty > 0 and age_tx.create_time is not null then datediff(curdate(),date(age_tx.create_time)) else 0 end stockAgeDays, wc.warning_days warningDays, case when (s.on_hand_qty-s.reserved_out_qty) <= p.warning_qty then 1 else 0 end quantityWarning, case when s.on_hand_qty > 0 and age_tx.create_time is not null and datediff(curdate(),date(age_tx.create_time)) >= wc.warning_days then 1 else 0 end ageWarning from jewelry_stock s join jewelry_product p on p.product_id=s.product_id left join age_boundary ab on ab.product_id=s.product_id left join jewelry_stock_transaction age_tx on age_tx.transaction_id=ab.boundary_id cross join warning_config wc
and (p.sku like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.product_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
and p.product_type=#{productType}
and (s.on_hand_qty-s.reserved_out_qty) <= p.warning_qty
and s.on_hand_qty > 0 and age_tx.create_time is not null and datediff(curdate(),date(age_tx.create_time)) >= wc.warning_days
and ((s.on_hand_qty-s.reserved_out_qty) <= p.warning_qty or (s.on_hand_qty > 0 and age_tx.create_time is not null and datediff(curdate(),date(age_tx.create_time)) >= wc.warning_days))

select coalesce(sum(i.qty),0) from jewelry_document_item i join jewelry_document d on d.document_id=i.document_id where d.doc_type='CUSTOMER_RETURN' and i.source_item_id=#{sourceItemId} and d.status in ('DRAFT','PENDING_FIRST','PENDING_SECOND','POSTED') and d.document_id != #{excludeDocumentId}

select coalesce(sum(i.good_qty+i.defect_qty),0) from jewelry_document_item i join jewelry_document d on d.document_id=i.document_id where d.doc_type='RETURN_INSPECT' and i.source_item_id=#{sourceItemId} and d.status in ('DRAFT','PENDING_FIRST','PENDING_SECOND','POSTED') and d.document_id != #{excludeDocumentId}

select source_item.*, source_item.qty-coalesce(processed.processed_qty,0) remaining_inspect_qty from jewelry_document_item source_item left join ( select inspected.source_item_id,sum(inspected.good_qty+inspected.defect_qty) processed_qty from jewelry_document_item inspected join jewelry_document inspect_doc on inspect_doc.document_id=inspected.document_id where inspect_doc.doc_type='RETURN_INSPECT' and inspect_doc.source_document_id=#{sourceDocumentId} and inspect_doc.status in ('DRAFT','PENDING_FIRST','PENDING_SECOND','POSTED') and inspect_doc.document_id != #{excludeDocumentId} group by inspected.source_item_id ) processed on processed.source_item_id=source_item.item_id where source_item.document_id=#{sourceDocumentId} and source_item.qty > coalesce(processed.processed_qty,0) order by source_item.item_id
select * from jewelry_document_item where document_id=#{documentId} order by item_id
